_about: What Fireflies already produces after a meeting (title, summary, transcript, action items with owner and spoken due date). Commitments imports this as-is; it does not run its own AI. Days are relative to the import date so the demo always works.
title: Analytics Dashboard Release · Go/No-Go Planning

overview: The analytics dashboard release goes out in 5 days.
Two UI bugs on the filters panel are still open; tablet and mobile regression can only start after they are fixed.
API load testing at peak traffic and customer release notes are needed before go-live.
Go/no-go call with pilot customers the day before release, after regression passes.
Updating the status page on release day was raised but no one took it.

sentences.text: Okay team, the analytics dashboard release goes out in 5 days. Let us lock who owns what today.
Two UI bugs are still open on the filters panel. I will fix the dashboard UI issues <mark>by tomorrow</mark>.
Once Arjun's UI fixes are in, I will run the tablet and mobile regression <mark>in 2 days</mark>.
The API is fine at normal load but I have not tested peak traffic. I will complete the API load testing <mark>in 3 days</mark>.
Customers will ask what changed. I will prepare the customer release notes <mark>in 3 days</mark>.
After Neha's regression passes, I will run the go/no-go call with our pilot customers <mark>in 4 days</mark>, the day before release.
Someone should update the status page <mark>on release day</mark>, we forgot last time.
Good point. And I will push the release itself <mark>in 5 days</mark> if the go/no-go is a yes.

action_items.text: Fix dashboard UI issues on the filters panel
Run go/no-go call with pilot customers
Update the status page on release day
